required.target: Complete causally delivered JSON tool output for the admitted scope, with explicit byte/type/structure limits; no fixture-fed answer or summary substituted for original.
Single actual decision request representation, UNTRUSTED data without authority, bounded final-input admission including repair and truthful token/cost/byte assumptions.
Confirmed-effect overflow or save failure preserves native settlement/identity and prevents fabricated success or automatic duplicate body.
Explicit checkpoint compatibility and resume, reservation lifecycle/accounting/idempotency/late results/crash behavior implementable at the current boundaries.
Minimum sufficient coherent design with unambiguous contracts/limits/errors/ordering, credible rejectable public-path acceptance and known consumers; no blocking HOW disguised as a future test.
T3 human authority before BUILD; no inference of other pending approvals, no runtime/parity/release PASS from paper review, original program scope retained.

originalRequirements.P100-004: Caso conhecido-bom passa e fixtures com efeito extra, evento perdido e resultado indevido falham; nenhum uso de ~/.dsh ou dado real.
originalRequirements.P100-014: Schemas/stream/usage/errors equivalentes nas rotas mapeadas; ausência de credencial falha fechada; provider real só com gate T4 próprio.
originalRequirements.P100-020: Turno com tools/approvals pode ser retomado e consultado sem perder ordem/vínculos; sessão v1 real preservada; versões desconhecidas recusadas.
originalRequirements.P100-021: Replay reconstrói pressão/usage; fatos/obrigações/aprovações preservados; overflow não chama provider; compaction cancelada não consome efeito.
